outcome: Levonorgestrel-releasing intrauterine system (LNG-IUS) malposition (downward displacement or expulsion)
cohort: The study included 99 adenomyosis patients treated at Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital between May 2021 and May 2023.
finding: A uterine transverse diameter exceeding 5.4 cm was associated with a significantly higher risk of LNG-IUS malposition in adenomyosis patients, with the risk increasing substantially beyond this threshold.
